summary: Farid attempts to offer Liza a prestigious job at his father's enterprise, but Abbas prompts him to offer a 'blow job'. Farid repeats it confidently, causing Liza to erupt in anger at the offensive proposition.

title: فريد ومستر لغات في أهضم موقف في ما في متلو
summary: Farid wants to offer Liza a shisha pipe, but Abbas translates hookah as 'you hooker'. When Farid asks Liza 'you hooker?', she immediately stands up and slaps both of them across the face.

title: ما في متلو - مستر لغات يلتقي عادل وهذا ما دار بينهما
summary: Mr. Loughat talks to Adel outside by an old black car about the US presidential elections, asking him if he supports the Republicans or the 'Democratian'.

title: ما في متلو - مستر لغات يلتقي عادل وهذا ما دار بينهما
summary: While discussing American presidential candidates next to the vintage car, Mr. Loughat insists that 'Kramp' is guaranteed to win.

summary: Mr. Loughat claims Trump's opponent stands no chance, referring to Hillary Clinton as 'Krinton' and calling her husband Nabil.

summary: Mr. Loughat brings up Bill Clinton's White House scandal, referring to Monica Lewinsky as 'Mona Twinsky'.

summary: When Adel offers coffee, Mr. Loughat asks for some 'baby foot' cookies on the side, confusing table soccer (baby-foot) with petits fours.

summary: When Adel complains about being bitten by insects, Mr. Loughat calls them 'Mostikoz' and imitates them zooming around like motorcycles.

summary: Mr. Loughat advises Adel to tear out the wooden floor in his home to prevent insect infestations, calling 'parquet' flooring 'pourquoi'.

title: ما في متلو - مستر لغات يلتقي عادل وهذا ما دار بينهما
summary: Mr. Loughat suggests replacing the parquet flooring with 'blaton', blending the Lebanese word for floor tiles (balat) with concrete (béton).

summary: Mr. Loughat recommends hiring a floor expert named Richard rather than an amateur, mispronouncing 'professionnel' as 'profacial'.
